chapters.label: The free kick, live
chapters.text: Seville, 1982. Brazil against Scotland at the World Cup, and Scotland lead one-nil! Free kick to Brazil, thirty yards out. Zico takes just two steps... Top corner! One-one!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, from behind. The ball rises up over the wall, then curls and dips, right into the top corner. Alan Rough can only stand and watch.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: Zico practised every day, with shirts hung in the top corners as targets. Your turn: aim over the wall, and let the curl bring the ball down.
